name: Operation Epic Fury — Iranian APT Dual-Platform Campaign (Android+Windows) 2026
description:
Original OSINT research into Operation Epic Fury — an Iranian-linked campaign targeting Israeli civilians with a fake RedAlert rocket alert app following military operations of 28 Feb 2026.

KEY ORIGINAL FINDINGS (not present in prior Unit 42 / CloudSEK / Cloudforce One / ClearSky / Trellix / Sophos reports):
1. Secondary Windows C2: 167.160.187.43 / 9732.5486311.xyz — 0/94 VirusTotal
2. Windows payload: LotAccessUI.EXE (trojanized AppEx Networks VPN 2016)
3. Infrastructure active since June 2025 (8 months pre-operation)
4. RDTSC anti-VM evasion (T1497.003) — C2 never contacted in sandbox → no public sandbox capture
5. Second Android APK: umgdn / com.net.alerts with Pushy.me C2
6. Tactical convergence with Arid Viper 2023 TTP pattern

Full technical report: https://paolocostanzo.github.io/operation-epic-fury-cyber-war-iran/
Detection rules (YARA + Sigma): https://github.com/paolocostanzo/operation-epic-fury-rules
Author: Paolo Costanzo — paolocostanzo.github.io
TLP: WHITE

indicators.title: LotAccess Primary Windows C2 — HostPapa AS36352 Ashburn VA
indicators.description: Primary C2 server for LotAccessUI.EXE Windows RAT. Documented by Unit 42 and CloudSEK. AppEx VPN API protocol on port 443.

indicators.title: LotAccess Secondary Windows C2 — RackNerd Toronto CA — 0/94 VT UNDISCLOSED
indicators.description: Secondary C2 server discovered via JARM fingerprint pivot. Had 0/94 VirusTotal detections at time of publication. Not documented by any prior vendor report. Active 17+ days post-operation.

indicators.title: Primary C2 domain — Android + Windows
indicators.description: Primary C2 domain registered 2025-06-23 via NameCheap. Used by both Android APK exfiltration endpoint (/analytics/submit.php) and as hostname alias for Windows C2 IP.

indicators.title: Secondary C2 domain — 0/94 VT UNDISCLOSED
indicators.description: Secondary C2 domain registered 2025-07-08 via NameCheap. Had 0/94 VirusTotal detections at publication. Resolves to 167.160.187.43. Shares JARM fingerprint with primary C2.

indicators.title: Secondary C2 base domain
indicators.description: Base domain for secondary C2 infrastructure. NameCheap / Withheld for Privacy ehf.

indicators.title: Android APK exfiltration endpoint — SMS/GPS/contacts
indicators.description: HTTP POST endpoint used by RedAlert fake APK (com.red.alertx) to exfiltrate SMS messages, GPS location, and contact list. Went offline ~2026-03-08 following Unit 42/CloudSEK takedown reports.

indicators.title: Pushy.me secondary C2 channel — stage 2 umgdn APK
indicators.description: Pushy.me push notification service used as resilient C2 channel in undisclosed stage 2 APK (com.net.alerts / umgdn). Survives backend takedown. Pushy.me itself is a legitimate service.

indicators.title: LotAccessUI.EXE v3 — trojanized AppEx VPN — Windows RAT
indicators.description: Latest version of LotAccess Windows RAT. 13/72 VT detections. CrowdStrike Falcon: CLEAN. RDTSC anti-VM evasion active — no public sandbox has ever captured C2 traffic. First submitted to VT ~2025-12.

indicators.title: LotAccessUI.EXE v1 — first submission 2025-12-16 (10 weeks pre-op)
indicators.description: First known version of LotAccess Windows RAT. First VirusTotal submission 2025-12-16, 10 weeks before the Feb 28 operation. 4/65 VT detections. Proves infrastructure was prepared months in advance.

indicators.title: RedAlert fake APK — com.red.alertx — stage 1 Android spyware
indicators.description: Primary Android spyware masquerading as RedAlert rocket alert app. Exfiltrates SMS, GPS, contacts to api.ra-backup.com/analytics/submit.php.

indicators.title: umgdn APK — com.net.alerts — stage 2 UNDISCLOSED — Pushy.me C2
indicators.description: Second Android spyware (stage 2), package com.net.alerts (umgdn). Not documented in any prior public report. Uses Pushy.me as resilient secondary C2 channel for push-based command delivery.

indicators.title: LotAccessUI.EXE v3 MD5
indicators.description: MD5 hash for LotAccess v3 Windows RAT sample.
